Summary: Support for InsurancePlan identifier search parameter with multipleAnd
Requirement: "The parameter may repeat in order to specify multiple values that must all be true"
Context: The insuranceplan-identifier search parameter allows searching for InsurancePlan resources by identifier. This requirement specifies that the server must support multiple repetitions of the identifier parameter where all specified values must match (AND logic).

Summary: Support for InsurancePlan identifier search parameter with multipleOr
Requirement: "The parameter may have multiple values (separated by comma) where at least one must be true"
Context: The insuranceplan-identifier search parameter allows searching for InsurancePlan resources by identifier. This requirement specifies that the server must support comma-separated values for the identifier parameter where at least one value must match (OR logic).

Requirement: "Server systems claiming conformance to this guide SHALL meet the capability statement expectation requirements identified in the Plan-Net CapabilityStatement and SHALL have a CapabilityStatement that has a CapabilityStatement.instantiates with a URL of http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-drug-formulary/CapabilityStatement/usdf-server or a URL to the appropriate version of the CapabilityStatement."
Context: Server systems must publish a CapabilityStatement that declares conformance to this IG through the instantiates element, allowing clients to discover server capabilities programmatically.

Summary: Plan-Net Server SHALL support all profiles defined in this Implementation Guide
Requirement: "The Plan-Net Server SHALL: Support all profiles defined in this Implementation Guide."
Context: This requirement establishes that the Plan-Net Server must support all profiles defined within the DaVinci PDEX Plan-Net Implementation Guide. This is a foundational capability requirement for the server implementation.

Summary: Plan-Net Server SHALL implement RESTful behavior according to FHIR specification
Requirement: "The Plan-Net Server SHALL: Implement the RESTful behavior according to the FHIR specification."
Context: This requirement mandates that the Plan-Net Server must conform to the RESTful behavior patterns defined in the FHIR specification, ensuring standard-compliant interactions.

Summary: Plan-Net Server SHALL return required response classes for errors
Requirement: "The Plan-Net Server SHALL: Return the following response classes: (Status 400): invalid parameter, (Status 401/4xx): unauthorized request, (Status 403): insufficient scope, (Status 404): unknown resource, (Status 410): deleted resource."
Context: This requirement specifies the error response codes that the server must return for various error conditions, ensuring proper HTTP status code handling for client error scenarios.

Summary: Plan-Net Server SHALL support json source formats for all Plan-Net interactions
Requirement: "The Plan-Net Server SHALL: Support json source formats for all Plan-Net interactions."
Context: This requirement mandates JSON format support for all interactions defined in the Plan-Net Implementation Guide, ensuring interoperability through JSON encoding.

Summary: Plan-Net Server SHALL support searchParameters on each profile individually and in combination
Requirement: "The Plan-Net Server SHALL: Support the searchParameters on each profile individually and in combination."
Context: This requirement establishes that the server must support all defined search parameters both when used individually and when combined together in queries, enabling comprehensive search capabilities.

Summary: Plan-Net Server SHALL support forward and reverse chaining on search parameters
Requirement: "The Plan-Net Server SHALL: Support forward and reverse chaining on all search parameters that specify the 'chain' property."
Context: This requirement mandates support for both forward and reverse chaining on search parameters that have the chain property defined, enabling complex relational queries across resources.
Conditionality Details: Only applies to search parameters that specify the 'chain' property

Summary: Plan-Net Server SHOULD support xml source formats for all Plan-Net interactions
Requirement: "The Plan-Net Server SHOULD: Support xml source formats for all Plan-Net interactions."
Context: This requirement recommends XML format support for all interactions defined in the Plan-Net Implementation Guide, providing additional format interoperability.
